description: The saved versions of a knowledge entry, newest first, a deleted entry's too, without their content: each version's number, what it did (created, edited, deleted, restored), its title, who saved it, when, and a fingerprint of its content (two versions with the same fingerprint have the same content). The first row is the newest version, whose number restore_knowledge_version needs. Long histories come a page at a time: send nextBefore from the answer as before.

before.description: Only versions numbered below this: the nextBefore of the previous page. Leave it out for the newest page.

knowledge_id.description: The entry (list_knowledge and search_knowledge give ids).

level.description: Which level to read: a project's knowledge (needs project_id), the workspace's, or CodeGene's platform guidance (read only). Leave it out for the project when project_id is sent, otherwise the workspace. A search hit names the level its entry is on.

project_id.description: The project the entry is in. May be left out: the entry's id finds its own project or the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_knowledge_versions
title: A knowledge entry's versions
